query:
SELECT s.id, s.name
                 FROM series s
                WHERE EXISTS (
                          SELECT 1 FROM series_works sw
                          JOIN manifestations m ON m.work_id = sw.work_id
                         WHERE sw.series_id = s.id
                      )
                  AND immutable_unaccent(s.name) ILIKE immutable_unaccent($1 || '%')
                ORDER BY s.name ASC
                LIMIT $2
